the screen: x 41, y 136, 110 × 73 px.

## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.4455 (spec 0.4444), screen at the exact 96:64 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://www.esato.com/gfx/phones/sonyericssonj110.jpg (frontal press render, white margin added)); geometry measured on a [photo](https://www.esato.com/gfx/phones/sonyericssonj110.jpg); specs: [gsmarena.com](https://www.gsmarena.com/sony_ericsson_j110-1844.php), [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/j110i/).
